insights.summary: In its first earnings call after listing, Symbiotec said FY27 should see about 20% revenue growth and 25% EBITDA growth (each plus or minus 5 points), with over 90% of revenue still from steroid and hormone APIs. Two new businesses, complex injectables and fermentation CDMO, have absorbed more than ₹1,000 Cr of capex and should begin earning in 6-12 months. Net debt was about ₹326 Cr after the ₹142 Cr IPO.

analyst_questions.topic: Is the guidance at consolidated level and what about profit?
analyst_questions.answer: Consolidated; PAT growth lower because of depreciation, cash PAT up more than 25%.

analyst_questions.answer: Depends on customer visibility and contracts; more capex from internal accruals as cash flow improves.
